svg.aria-label: How jukecord works. You and your friends use slash commands in Discord, the panel, the jukecord command or the HTTP API, and every one of them goes through one list of actions and one permission check, the DJ role. jukecord fetches tracks from YouTube, SoundCloud and the other sites yt-dlp reads, through its own proxy that reaches only public addresses, evens out their loudness once and keeps them as Opus. Each Discord server has one queue and one player, and the player is the clock: here it plays Glass Garden (Live at the Old Hall), at 1:09 of 3:00. Rainbow lines carry the music people hear: the bot plays it live in the voice channel from the clock's place, at the volume the server set, and a browser that presses Listen here plays the same file within 0.3 seconds of the clock, at its own volume.
